questions.question:
रामः पुस्तकं पठति।

The verb पठति is:
questions.explanation: पठति takes the object 'पुस्तकम्', so it is a सकर्मक (transitive) verb.

questions.question:
बालकः हसति।

The verb हसति is:
questions.explanation: हसति (laughs) does not require an object, so it is अकर्मक.

questions.question:
गुरुः शिष्याय पुस्तकं ददाति।

The verb ददाति is:
questions.explanation: ददाति involves two grammatical objects in the course framework (the thing given and the recipient), so it is classified as द्विकर्मक.

questions.question: Identify the पुरुष and वचन of पठसि.
questions.explanation: The ending -सि indicates मध्यम पुरुष एकवचन.

questions.question: Identify the पुरुष and वचन of गच्छामः.
questions.explanation: The ending -आमः indicates उत्तम पुरुष बहुवचन.

questions.question: The verb गच्छति is formed from which धातु?
questions.explanation: गच्छति is derived from the धातु गम्.

questions.question: The verb नमामि is formed from which धातु?
questions.explanation: नमामि is derived from the धातु नम्.

questions.question: The धातु भू belongs to which गण?
questions.explanation: According to the handbook, भू belongs to भ्वादिगण.

questions.question:
बालकः पुस्तकं पठति।

What is the boy doing?
questions.explanation: The verb पठति means 'reads', so the sentence means 'The boy is reading a book.'

questions.question:
गुरुः शिष्याय पुस्तकं ददाति।

Why is ददाति classified as द्विकर्मक?
options: Because it involves both the thing given and the recipient.
Because it is in प्रथम पुरुष.
questions.explanation: In the grammar taught in your handbook, ददाति is द्विकर्मक because the action involves both the object being given (पुस्तकम्) and the recipient (शिष्याय).

questions.question: The verb पठति is formed from which धातु?
questions.explanation: पठति is derived from the धातु पठ्.

questions.question: The verb भवति is formed from which धातु?
questions.explanation: भवति is derived from the धातु भू.

questions.question: The verb वदति is formed from which धातु?
questions.explanation: वदति comes from the धातु वद्.

गुरुः सत्यं वदति।

questions.explanation: According to the handbook, both भू and गम् belong to भ्वादिगण.

questions.explanation: पिबति takes the object जलम्, so it is a सकर्मक verb.

राजा तिष्ठति।

The verb तिष्ठति is:
questions.explanation: तिष्ठति ('stands') does not require a direct object, so it is अकर्मक.

questions.question: The धातु पठ् belongs to which गण?
questions.explanation: According to your handbook, पठ् belongs to भ्वादिगण.

Why is पश्यति classified as सकर्मक?
options: Because it has a direct object.
questions.explanation: The verb acts on मित्रम्, which is its direct object.

questions.question: Which verb is derived from the धातु नम्?
questions.explanation: नमति is formed from the धातु नम्.

Which statement is correct about वदन्ति?
questions.explanation: The ending -न्ति indicates प्रथम पुरुष बहुवचन.

questions.question:

Why is पठति classified as सकर्मक?
options: Because it has a direct object.
questions.explanation: पुस्तकम् is the direct object of पठति, making the verb सकर्मक.

questions.question:
बालकः हसति।

Why is हसति classified as अकर्मक?
options: Because no direct object is required.
questions.explanation: The meaning is complete without a direct object.

questions.question:

questions.explanation: The ending -आवः marks उत्तम पुरुष द्विवचन.

questions.question:
बालकाः उद्याने क्रीडन्ति।

What tells you the subject is plural?
questions.explanation: Both the subject (बालकाः) and the verb ending (-न्ति) indicate बहुवचन.

questions.question:
भवामः

Which part of the word helps identify the वचन?
questions.explanation: The ending -आमः indicates उत्तम पुरुष बहुवचन.

questions.question: Which pair is derived from the same धातु?
questions.explanation: Both forms are derived from the धातु गम्.

questions.question:
गुरुः सत्यं वदति।

Why is वदति classified as सकर्मक?
options: Because सत्यम् is the direct object.
Because the sentence has a subject.
questions.explanation: The verb acts upon सत्यम्, making it a transitive (सकर्मक) verb.

questions.question:
रामः पुस्तकं पठति।

Choose the correct sentence to mean 'Rama and Lakshmana read the book.'
questions.explanation: रामः लक्ष्मणश्च is a compound subject (two individuals joined by च), so the verb becomes द्विवचन: पठतः.

questions.explanation: वयं requires the verb पठामः.
